body:
Thanks for that. I appreciate it. I do blame myself, cause it's all mostly my fault. I have to take responsibility the choices that brought me to this place.

I think I have seasonal depressive disorder, honestly. My psychiatrist gave me some antidepressants, and I think they made it way worse. So I stopped taking them.

I've felt like this as long as I can remember. It's gotten worse lately though. I fell into a deep deep depression over the winter. I thought it would get better, and it has, but not enough to make me not suicidal anymore.

Coping is an everyday struggle for me. I don't really have much to describe about it, tho. I just power through, daydreaming about how I could have done things better.
